title: Post-it yelimi 1968 yilda muvaffaqiyatsiz tajriba edi

scenes.text: 1968 yilda 3M olimi Spenser Silver kuchli yelim o'rniga kuchsiz yelim yaratdi.
Bir necha yil hech kim undan foydalanishni bilmadi.
scenes.keywords: sticky note peeled off surface close up

scenes.text: 1973-1974 yillarda hamkasbi Art Fray uni xatcho'p sifatida ishlatishni o'ylab topdi.
Post-it qog'ozlari 1980 yilda Amerika bo'ylab sotuvga chiqdi.
scenes.keywords: colorful sticky notes on office wall

scenes.text: Chiqmagan g'oyani tashlashdan oldin unga boshqa joy izla.

description: 1968 yilda 3M olimi Spenser Silver kuchli yelim o'rniga kuchsiz yelim yaratdi; Post-it qog'ozlari 12 yil o'tib, 1980 yilda AQShda sotuvga chiqdi. 1973-1974 yillarda Art Fray undan xatcho'p uchun foydalanishni o'ylab topgan (manbalarda yil farq qiladi). Sening tashlab qo'ygan g'oyang boshqa joyda ishlashi mumkinmi?
source: 3M Post-it Brand: History of Post-it Notes (1968 Silver adhesive; US launch April 1980; Boise test 1978), https://www.post-it.com/3M/en_US/post-it/contact-us/about-us/ ; Minnesota Historical Society MNopedia: Post-it Notes (Fry idea dated 1973; 1977 Press 'n Peel tests; 1978 Boise; 1980 national launch), https://www.mnhs.org/mnopedia/search/index/thing/post-it-notes ; Smithsonian Magazine: Eureka! (Silver never found a use for the adhesive), https://www.smithsonianmag.com/science-nature/eureka-89414180/ . Note: Fry's idea is dated 1973 (MNHS) or 1974 (Smithsonian podcast piece), so the script says 1973-1974.
